name: tabs-changed-bookmarked
description: S→C tabs.changed push (protocol 1.6, phase 11): the TRI-STATE `bookmarked` flag round-trips. `true` = this tab's URL is bookmarked somewhere in the tree; `false` = it is not; ABSENT means UNKNOWN — the extension could not read the bookmark tree (getTree() failed or the bookmarks permission is missing), NOT 'not bookmarked'. That is exactly why `false` is emitted EXPLICITLY rather than skipped, deliberately unlike the skip-when-absent `icon`/`groupId` precedent: an empty star for an unreadable tree would be the misreport D-11 forbids. A tab with the key absent renders no star button at all.
